title: Michael's own memory: frozen at the wheel, bright light, human-shaped blurs
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I I do remember the simple fact that there's a big bright light in front of us. I do remember that it come close, it go back out and everything.

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard, says that around November 1977 he was in a truck with his partner, Mario Woods, at a nuclear missile site called November 5, part of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says he froze at the wheel as a big bright light in front of them came close and pulled back again, and that he glimpsed blurry shapes like people. If true, it would mean something unknown approached a nuclear weapons site and its guards.
